## E — Market signal

Status: no market research was performed for this section; the upstream competitive-intelligence pointer was not supplied for this run, so market size, pass rate, rooms, voice-of-customer quotes, persona, seasonality, price and success bar are recorded as typed debt (verify — AL-SEC-ONE-E-MARKET).
Known context only from the product frame: buyers are first-time Alabama applicants and the parents of teen drivers preparing for the knowledge test; for this section the pressing need is knowing which documents to bring and when a teen may start driving with a companion.
Ad hooks, verbatim learner pain phrases and a named differentiation gap must come from sourced recon in a later pass, never invented here.
